description: Stay in a beautiful and spacious apartment offering an ideal location for your travels.Located on the 3rd floor of a building with an elevator, this bright accommodation can comfortably accommodate up to 7 people. It has many advantages, such as:- a free parking space, - two balconies to enjoy the outdoors, - a perfect location (4 min walk to the metro)- an easy connection to Paris and airportsLooking forward to hosting you!The spaceWe are delighted to present our spacious and practical apartment, ideal for your stay:Listing description 🏠 • A large living area including an open equipped kitchen, a dining area, and a living area with sofa bed and TV. This room gives access to a balcony equipped with outdoor furniture. • 3 comfortable bedrooms, each with a double bed. Two bedrooms have direct access to a balcony, and the third is equipped with a TV. • Two bathrooms with shower, one of which also includes a toilet. • A separate toilet for extra comfort. • Two balconies, perfect for relaxing. • A free parking space, included in your stay. 🅿️ (maximum height: 1.70 meters) • A laundry area with washing machine and dryer.🧺 For your convenience, bed linen and a large bath towel per person are provided.📍Our apartment is in a prime location, close to public transport and the main tourist attractions.🚇 Metro stations: • Carrefour Pleyel (line 13): just a 4-minute walk. • Saint-Denis Pleyel (line 14): also accessible in 4 minutes on foot.Line 14 allows you to reach Paris in 10 minutes and Orly Airport in 40 minutes thanks to a direct connection🛫.🏟️Close to the Stade de France: • 7-minute drive. • 13 minutes by bus.🏬You will find within walking distance: restaurants, cafes, bakeries, and supermarkets to make your trip easier.Looking forward to hosting you and offering you an unforge
